div.h1: Recommended for quality, reliability and fair prices
div.p: JKHA is rated 4.8 out of 5 from 108 MyBuilder reviews.

article.p: “Very good workmanship, fully committed to the task, a caring personality and the lowest estimate for a job well done. I've recommended him to my neighbour and other recommendations to follow.”
“Work was completed as specified at the agreed price.”

article.h3: Solid wood installation in living room and hallway
article.p: “Perfect job. Timely response, communication was great and the work was perfect. Rachid is very efficient and cleaned up after himself.”
“A very professional and efficient service from JKHA. We are delighted with the overall finish and plan to contact him again for another job. Highly recommend.”

article.h3: Fit laminate wood flooring in my flat
article.p: “Rachid was fantastic. He re-did my flooring quickly, professionally and to a very high standard. He made helpful suggestions and left the house looking immaculate.”
“Rachid attended my property and did an amazing job. He was very knowledgeable and helpful with advice. I will definitely use him again in the future.”
“Friendly, punctual, conscientious and did the works for a reasonable rate. He tidied the place after work and went out of his way to help with materials.”
“Rachid and his son took care to protect the house, worked hard without a break and cleared all debris from the old fence. Very pleased with the new fence and repair.”
“Rachid was great from start to finish. His price was competitive, communication was quick and clear and the work was finished to a high standard.”
“He arrived on time, was polite and friendly, offered advice and laid the floor super quick. The work was excellent and his fee worked with my budget.”
“Very impressed with Rachid's work. The flooring was laid quickly and to a high standard. Communication was good and the quote was very competitive.”
“Absolutely fantastic job. Good quality work, efficient, valuable advice and very transparent with the costings. The flooring transformed the house.”
